SensitiveString.description:
SensitiveString is a string type that prevents accidental exposure of secrets.
It redacts in JSON/fmt output unless explicitly accessed via .Expose().

Encryption at rest is handled by the GORM "sensitive" serializer
(api/internal/lib/secrets). Fields must be tagged: `gorm:"serializer:sensitive"`

Note: map-based GORM Updates (map[string]any{"value": ...}) bypass serializers.
Always use struct-based operations for SensitiveString fields.

Redaction:
  - JSON serialization: always returns "" (empty string)
  - fmt.Sprintf with %s, %v, %#v: always returns "[REDACTED]"
  - Only .Expose() returns the actual value

Encryption is enabled when SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var is set.
Values are stored as "enc:v2:<encrypted_dek>:<encrypted_data>" in the database.
Key rotation only re-encrypts the DEK, not the data.

WebhookPayload.description: WebhookPayload is the envelope for outbound webhook deliveries.

Widget.description:
Widget represents an interactive widget for display in chat
Type is either "ui" (structured nodes) or "html" (raw HTML)
For "ui" widgets, data-bound nodes read values from ToolInvocation.Data

WidgetAction.description: WidgetAction represents an action triggered by a widget button

WidgetActionButton.description: WidgetActionButton represents a button in a widget's action bar

WidgetActionResult.description: WidgetActionResult represents the result of a widget action submission

WidgetFormData.description: WidgetFormData represents the form data collected from widget inputs

WidgetNode.description: WidgetNode represents a UI element in a widget (text, input, select, etc.)

disabled.description: Control props (Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, DatePicker, Button)

onClickAction.description: Action handler for buttons (form data is collected locally and sent with action)

WidgetSelectOption.description: WidgetSelectOption represents an option in a select widget

WorkerCPU.description: WorkerCPU describes a CPU attached to a worker (contract-only, no gorm).

WorkerCPUConfig.description: WorkerCPUConfig defines CPU allocation for a worker.

WorkerConfig.description: WorkerConfig defines how workers are allocated on an engine.

WorkerDTO.description: WorkerDTO is the full API response for a worker.

WorkerGPU.description: WorkerGPU describes a GPU attached to a worker (contract-only, no gorm).

WorkerGPUConfig.description: WorkerGPUConfig defines GPU allocation for a worker.

WorkerRAM.description: WorkerRAM describes RAM attached to a worker (contract-only, no gorm).

WorkerRunRequest.description: WorkerRunRequest is the request body for worker /run endpoint.

WorkerSetupRequest.description: WorkerSetupRequest is the request body for worker /setup endpoint.

WorkerStatus.description: WorkerStatus represents the status of a worker.

WorkerSummary.description: WorkerSummary is a lightweight worker response.

WorkerTelemetry.description: WorkerTelemetry is the minimal telemetry data engine sends per worker.

WsSessionEndPayload.description: WsSessionEndPayload notifies engine to clear worker's session lease

WsTaskCancelResultPayload.description: WsTaskCancelResultPayload is sent from engine to API with cancel outcome.
